lead: Practices that move to Talbrunn before the end of October pay the reduced monthly price for their first twelve months. After that the plan continues at the ordinary rate; nothing renews at a surprise figure.
period: per month for the first 12 months, net
note: Offer valid for practices signing up on or before 31 October 2026. From month thirteen the ordinary Praxis price of €89 net per month applies, and we write to you a month before that happens. Not combinable with the new-practice reduction.
